confirmedNewBugs.title: Importing a plain-text (.txt) file populates only the rich representation: the Markdown source view of the imported document is completely blank (imported content invisible), and the first source-mode edit silently discards the imported text entirely
confirmedNewBugs.feature: F15 local imports x F21 markdown/source gutter
repro: 1. Import a .txt file via Import dialog > Files… (e.g. 3 lines 'line one/line two/line three'; reproduced with BOTH CRLF and LF line endings).

2. Doc created; rich view shows the paragraphs; __np3.doc().richHtml = '

line one

…'; __np3.doc().markdown = '' (EMPTY).
3. Switch View > Markdown source: #sourceText textarea is EMPTY — none of the imported content is visible.
4. Type a single character in source mode and switch back to rich view.
5. Observed: richHtml = '', document now contains ONLY the typed character; the imported paragraphs are gone.
confirmedNewBugs.expected: Source view shows the serialized text of the imported document (or at minimum refuses to commit an empty source over non-empty rich content); a mode switch must not make imported content invisible, and an edit must not destroy it.
confirmedNewBugs.observed: Blank source view for a content-bearing document; destructive first edit with no warning.
controls: .md import sets BOTH representations (l2d-a.md: markdown byte-identical to fixture) — proves the importer CAN fill both and the gap is specific to the .txt path.
LF-only and CRLF .txt both reproduce — line endings are not the trigger.

Same-session .html import (l2d-table.html) created table + rich content (markdown also initially empty — same lazy-serialization gap applies to rich-only imports; the demonstrated loss used the .txt path).
confirmedNewBugs.sourceMechanism: Import IO path (original ~L4797) writes richHtml for plain-text inputs without serializing markdown; source-mode activation binds #sourceText.value to doc.markdown directly (setMode ~L4550) — empty markdown renders as empty source; the source->rich commit replaces richHtml wholesale.
confirmedNewBugs.impact: Silent data loss for imported plain-text documents on first source-mode use; user cannot even see their content in source mode to know it exists.
confirmedNewBugs.fixDirection: Serialize richHtml to markdown when entering source mode if markdown is empty (or on import completion); guard the source->rich commit against replacing non-empty rich content with a first-edit empty/short source without confirmation.
